brand.purpose: SamePage wordmark beside the S symbol.

section.purpose: Section headings with a count pill or tally.

title.purpose: Proposal title in a motion card.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Light mode only (--shadow): every card, focus tile and the active tab. Dark mode sets --shadow to none and gives cards a 1px --line border.

shadows.name: avatar-cut

motion.name: state-fade

breakpoints.name: stack-aside
breakpoints.purpose: Below: the 340px aside drops under the main column; focus tiles go from four columns to two.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Below: the area rail becomes a horizontal scrolling strip; the workstream board becomes one column.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below: the rail becomes a top bar with a four-column icon-over-label nav; page padding 20px / 16px / 56px; comparisons stack; the hero icon tile hides.

focus.name: field-focus
focus.value: outline: 2px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: transparent

themes.mechanism: A prefers-color-scheme: dark media query on :root redefines the tokens and sets color-scheme: dark; no manual toggle. Dark values are the -dark tokens in the frontmatter. navy, ivory, coral, rail, rail-tx and rail-mut do not change, so the rail stays navy in both themes. In dark mode the hot focus tile becomes --hot-soft with a coral border, and .card gains a 1px --line border.

icons.style: Lucide-style line icons inlined as SVG: 24px grid, 2px stroke, round caps and joins, currentColor. 18px in nav and inline, 16px in buttons, 17px in type tiles, 22px in the entry hero.

logo.usage: The S symbol is inlined at 28px beside the wordmark: ivory strips on the navy rail, navy strips on the bare error page; the linking curve is always coral #FF6B4A. The favicon is the app icon (navy rounded square, rx 22 on a 96 grid).

narrative.northStar: The Same Page, at a Glance
narrative.overview:
The dashboard is the logo made into a room: an ink-navy rail carrying the S symbol down the left, an ivory desk to its right, and white sheets laid on it. One colour, the coral of the logo's thread, is reserved for whatever is waiting on the person looking. Everything else is meant to be scanned rather than read: each kind of entry has its own hue and line icon, each person has a stable avatar colour, and every status is a dot with a word. The density sits between a ledger and a dashboard: cards carry real named things (a proposal title, a workstream name), never anonymous metrics.

The world is brand-led. Navy (#14213d), ivory (#f4f1ea) and coral (#ff6b4a) come straight from `docs/brand/` and are used as the product's own colours, not as accents on a neutral grey. One sans family carries every role; hierarchy is size and weight. Depth is a single soft navy-tinted shadow in light mode and a hairline border in dark mode. Motion is limited to 150ms colour fades.

The signature device is the division tally: one short tick per person, grouped by the position they took, the carried side in green, with the score written as "2–1". It appears beside every decision in timelines and at the head of a decision's Positions section.
keyCharacteristics: Navy rail with the S symbol and an icon nav; ivory ground; white cards with a soft shadow.
Coral only for what needs you, plus "you are here" markers.
Colour-coded by kind (seven entry-type hues with tinted icon tiles) and by person (six avatar hues hashed from the person id).
Status always as a dot chip: dot, word, 12% tint.
One sans stack, weights 650/600/400, tabular figures for every time and count.
Light and dark themes switched by `prefers-color-scheme` only; no toggle.

rules.name: The Needs-You Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral marks only what is waiting on the viewer (Accept, the verdict count, the hot tile, a hot section count, the verdict edge) and where the viewer is (active nav icon, current timeline node, caret, focus ring). It never decorates, never fills a large surface in light mode, and never carries body text on a light ground.

rules.name: The Kind-and-Person Rule
rules.body: Colour names a kind of entry or a person, nothing else. Entry types keep their fixed hue and icon; people keep their hashed avatar hue. A new surface reuses these assignments; it does not invent a new hue for emphasis.

rules.name: The Dot-and-Word Rule
rules.body: Status is never colour alone: a 6px dot, the status word, and a 12% tint of the tone, in a pill.

rules.name: The One Sans Rule
rules.body: One family, three working weights (650 headings, 600 titles and labels, 400 text; 700 only for numerals, counts and avatar initials). Hierarchy comes from size and weight, never from a second face.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every `time`, count, score and tile numeral uses tabular figures, so columns of counts and dates align.

rules.name: The Capped Growth Rule
rules.body: Anything that accumulates gets a limit or a way to narrow it from the first build: the feed shows 50 rows and then "…and N more", the Done lane shows 6 and folds the rest behind "Show N more", proposals get Open/Rejected tabs plus word and area filters, and views show one area at a time.

rules.name: The Soft Sheet Rule
rules.body: One elevation level only. Light mode lifts sheets with the single Sheet shadow and no border; dark mode removes the shadow and draws a hairline border. Never stack shadows, never use a hard offset shadow, never add a shadow to signal hover (hover darkens the border instead).

dos: Do reserve Thread Coral (#ff6b4a) for what needs the viewer and for "you are here" markers, and put navy text on it, never white.
Do show status as a dot chip: 6px dot, the word, a 12% tint, pill-shaped.
Do lead every entry with its type tile (type hue at 13% tint, Lucide-style 2px-stroke icon) and every person with their hashed avatar colour.
Do make every count name what it counts: a focus tile's caption lists the actual titles or kinds behind its number.
Do use the division tally wherever a decision's positions are summarised, with the carried side in Carried Green and the score as "2–1".
Do set times, counts and scores in tabular figures.
Do cap or filter anything that accumulates (feed 50, Done lane 6, tabs and filters on proposals, one area at a time on views).
Do keep light-mode cards borderless with the Sheet shadow, and dark-mode cards shadowless with a 1px Navy Rule border.
donts: Don't use coral as decoration, as a large fill in light mode, or for body text on ivory or white.
Don't convey status, consensus or kind by colour alone; pair it with a word, a dot or an icon.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a serif; hierarchy is size and weight in the one sans stack.
Don't add gradients, vanity metrics or anonymous KPI numbers; a tile without named contents does not ship.
Don't stack shadows, use hard offset shadows, or add shadows on hover.
Don't let a growing list render unbounded.
